artworks.title: Bust of an Old Man with Flowing Beard and White Sleeve
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of an elderly man from the shoulders up, depicted in a three-quarter view. He has a full head of curly hair and a long beard. His facial features include a prominent forehead, deep-set eyes, and a large nose. He appears to be wearing a textured garment around his shoulders. There are no objects, jewelry, or background elements in the image.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait in a Cap, Open-Mouthed
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.2 x 4.5 cm (2 1/16 x 1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: Printed with black ink on ivory-white paper, the round face of a young man with wide open eyes and pursed lips almost fills this vertical etching. His face and hair are rendered in detail but only a few details of his clothing are sketched in. He appears to look at us from over his left shoulder with his head tipped very slightly back. His eyebrows are raised and gathered together, and the whites of his eyes show over his irises. He has a rounded nose, and his pursed lips are slightly parted under a wispy mustache. His short hair curls out from under a dark, floppy cap.

artworks.title: The Blind Fiddler
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a man playing a violin. He is standing and facing slightly to the right, looking down at the violin. The man appears older with distinct facial features, wearing a hat with hair sticking out. His clothing is layered and loose, including a coat, wide trousers, and shoes. The drawing uses detailed cross-hatching. The man is holding a violin and bow. A small dog on a leash is in the foreground, and there is a tree to the left. In the background, there is another individual near a suggested structure, with minimal detail overall.

artworks.title: The Blind Fiddler
artworks.description: The image is a sketch featuring a person standing with a leaning posture. The person has a bearded face, hair partially covered by a tall hat with a plume, and is dressed in a loose-fitting coat and pants. They are holding a small bagpipe. In the background, there is another figure in a garment adjusting an object. The background includes sketchy representations of trees or vegetation.

artworks.title: A Peasant Calling Out: "tis vinnich kout" (It's biting cold)
artworks.description: In this drawing, only the upper part of a person's body is shown, hunched over with their head turned slightly to the side. The person's face has deep lines, a prominent nose, and curly, unkempt hair under a cap. They are dressed in a layered garment that appears ragged and worn, with visible stitching and tears. Another figure is drawn smaller, seated with a stick or pole in their hands. The background is plain, with linework suggesting texture and depth. Handwriting at the top of the image includes the name "Rembrandt" and the year 1634.

artworks.title: A Peasant Replying: "Dats niet" (That's nothing)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing sideways and slightly angled away from the viewer in profile. He has distinct facial features, a long beard, and wears a hat over curly hair. His clothing is loose-fitting and rugged, consisting of a textured coat, baggy pants tucked into boots. He appears to be holding something in his right hand. In the background, there is a small figure drawn in a similar style. The top of the image has handwritten text.

artworks.title: Old Woman Sleeping
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man sitting with his head resting on his left hand, with his eyes closed. He is wearing a headscarf or turban, fur collar, glove, and a decorative bracelet or bangle on his wrist. The background consists of crosshatched lines.

artworks.title: Old Bearded Man in a High Fur Cap, with Eyes Closed
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a person shown from the shoulders up, in a profile position. The person's facial features are distinguished, with prominent eyebrows and a large, bushy beard. Their hair is full and thick, tucked under a large, textured hat. The clothing appears layered or textured, possibly representing a robe. The person is surrounded by a plain, softly shaded background. The signature "Rembrandt" is visible on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etching of a group of people gathered around a bed. A bearded man lies on the bed while various other figures surround him. The figures include an elderly man with a staff, a seated woman with a child, and others in robes. One figure wears a cap-like headpiece. The setting appears to be indoors with cross-hatched background suggesting walls or an arched ceiling. The scene conveys a solemn atmosphere.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Hay Barn and a Flock of Sheep
artworks.description: The image shows a serene rural landscape with an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is near the upper third of the image, balancing the sky and landscape. In the distance, there are trees and a rustic building. The etching has detailed line work capturing textures. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink on slightly worn, beige paper. A small stream is in the foreground, reflecting grasses. Figures are visible to the left near a bridge or path, observing the landscape. The artwork depicts rural tranquility with attention to detail and composition.

artworks.title: French Canal and American Cranes
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white drawing of a large industrial scene with a massive crane at the top. The view is slightly elevated, showing the industrial landscape with tracks, construction materials, and a waterway in the distance. Ships and industrial structures can be seen against the sky. The style features dynamic, sketchy brushstrokes conveying movement and activity. The color palette is monochrome with various shades of black and grey, highlighting the details and contrasts in the scene.

artworks.title: The Steel Bridge
artworks.description: The image shows a steel bridge spanning across a river, with cliffs and trees obscuring the horizon. The bridge has an arched framework and lattice structure, rendered in pencil strokes with shadows and outlines. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of grey, depicting the rocky shore, water, vegetation, and bridge. Rocks and foliage are seen near the water, while city architecture can be seen in the distance beyond the cliffs.

artworks.title: Old and New Rome, Victor Emanuel Monument
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape viewed from an elevated angle with a cluster of architectural structures. The horizon is not distinct, with buildings and tower outlines rising into the sky. The drawing utilizes expressive brushstrokes and detailed line work, especially in depicting ancient ruins with visible columns. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and gray, emphasizing architectural details. More structures can be seen in the distance, and the sky above features soft, sweeping strokes possibly indicating a cloudy day.

artworks.title: The Perambulator
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an industrial scene in a factory. The drawing depicts the interior of a large industrial facility with machinery and bursts of fiery light. The setting appears to be a foundry or steel mill, with a crucible pouring molten metal. The details emphasize the rough surfaces and shadows, creating a composition rich with tonal variations.

artworks.title: The Great Hammer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an industrial machine in a large factory setting. The image shows a massive vertical machine in the center of a high-ceilinged factory interior. The structure around it is illustrated with various lines and textures, suggesting metal beams and architectural frameworks. The floor is scattered with rods or raw materials, enhancing the industrial atmosphere. The lighting is dramatic, casting deep shadows and highlighting the details of the machinery and structure.

artworks.title: Falls Station, Niagara
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a train in motion on tracks in the foreground. In the background, there is a waterfall with cascading water captured in swift brushstrokes. The horizon is partially hidden by mist and distant land formations. The drawing style is sketch-like with pencil marks creating texture. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of black and gray capturing the natural and man-made elements in the scene.

artworks.title: The Balloon-Shed
artworks.description: The image depicts a grassy field with a large aircraft hangar in the center. The horizon is low with distant low structures and terrain visible. The hangar has a wide entrance, leading to a dark interior. The artwork is created with graphite, showing sketchy pencil strokes for texture. The sky has small aircraft in flight drawn with quick strokes. The color palette is monochrome with shades of gray and black. Grounded biplanes are scattered throughout the field.

artworks.title: Building Engines for the Allies
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a industrial scene with locomotives and workers in a train workshop or factory. There are multiple locomotives in different stages of assembly or repair, and many workers are shown working. The setting is detailed, showcasing the teamwork and industrious nature of the environment. The drawing includes structural elements indicating the scale of the industrial setting, with an emphasis on mechanical complexity and human effort.

artworks.title: Making War Locomotives
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a train station scene. It includes a steam locomotive marked "U.S.A. 3122," a grand station interior with arched windows and chandeliers, and various individuals in motion. The drawing conveys an industrial early 20th-century train travel atmosphere through shading and linework.

artworks.title: The Flying Locomotive
artworks.description: This is an image showing a locomotive inside an industrial warehouse. The scene is depicted in monochrome, featuring a large indoor space filled with machinery and locomotives. The drawing showcases detailed shading, providing texture to the walls, floor, and equipment in the setting. A large steam locomotive is being lifted or moved by a crane system, with beams of light entering from high windows, emphasizing the industrial atmosphere of the space.

artworks.title: The Gun-Testing Ground
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an industrial scene with artillery and machinery. The image shows a detailed view of a large industrial facility or construction site focused on the assembly or maintenance of artillery pieces. The scene includes large cannons, gantries, cranes, rocky cliffs, and foliage. The lower section of the image shows intricate depictions of heavy machinery components like wheels, gears, and gun barrels. The elements are sketched with strong line work and contrast, emphasizing depth and complexity. The style of the drawing is detailed and technical.

artworks.title: The Iron Gate, Charleroi
artworks.description: The image displays an industrial scene from a direct frontal viewpoint. Railway tracks extend from the bottom of the image towards a distant horizon, with structures including a bridge with a latticework pattern obscuring the horizon. The brushstrokes in the image resemble etching or lithography, creating a textured effect. The color palette is monochromatic with contrasts of black and white, emphasizing the industrial theme. Smoking chimneys in the distance add to the industrial atmosphere conveyed through detailed line work.

artworks.title: The Great Chimney, the Motor Park
artworks.description: The image features a cityscape seen from an elevated viewpoint, with a river winding through an industrial area. On the left, there are structures or machinery, adding to the industrial feel. The horizon is high in the composition with smokestacks and buildings stretching into the distance. A tall smokestack dominates the skyline, emitting smoke into a cloudy sky. The painting style includes sketch-like brushstrokes, with quick lines and shading creating a hazy, slightly abstract representation of the industrial landscape. The monochromatic color scheme of black and white emphasizes the gritty texture of the scene, enhancing the industrial atmosphere.
